title: Message Queue
description: Build a job queue system with enqueue, status tracking, worker processing, and queue statistics.

steps.title: Add job to queue
steps.description: Create POST /queue that accepts a job payload and enqueues it, returning a 201 with a unique jobId.
hints: Generate a unique ID for each job using uuid or a counter
Store jobs in a map with status 'pending'

steps.title: Get job status
steps.description: Create GET /queue/:jobId/status that returns the current status of a job (pending, processing, or done).
hints: Look up the job in the queue by jobId
Return 404 if the job doesn't exist

steps.title: Worker picks next job
steps.description: Create GET /queue/worker/next that returns the next pending job and sets its status to 'processing'.
hints: Find the first job with status 'pending'
Return the job data to the worker

steps.title: Complete a job
steps.description: Create POST /queue/worker/:jobId/complete that marks a job as 'done' after a worker finishes processing it.
hints: Find the job by jobId and update its status to 'done'
Return 404 if the job doesn't exist
The worker calls this endpoint after processing

steps.title: Queue statistics
steps.description: Create GET /queue/stats that returns queue statistics like total jobs, pending count, processing count, and done count.
hints: Count jobs by their status field
Use Object.values(queue) to iterate over all jobs
